evidence_scope: Bounded core key capture and Studio scalar key-capture/retiming adapters. This does not qualify visible scalar Dopesheet gestures or complete the broader Composer goal.
tested_behavior: Capture combined, X and Y pins at the same socket and exact authored clock in selection order.
Read effective canonical scalar arrays for shared aliases even without local scalar key projections, including warm arrays whose selected local separated flag is false.
Preserve physical IDs for local captures and clear IDs for shared or retired scalar alias captures; resolve independent local scalar owners and retired generations.
Refuse cold arrays, duplicate identities, invalid selectors, missing keys, malformed uncaptured scalar payloads or clocks, and byte/work-limit overruns without replacing the destination snapshot.
Carry explicit axis selectors through Studio mixed retiming and clipboard copies, with signed fractional clocks, driver and ID reset on copy, atomic history, undo/redo and stale-pin refusal.
Use the same weighted axis lookup admission in capture and editing. A bounded Compile validates capture input while document, selection and old-result residency are admitted.
